mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_draft WHERE app_id = #{appId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_draft (app_id, name, config, status, agent_type, memory_schema, reference_turns, creator, create_time, updater, update_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{name}, #{config}, #{status}, #{agentType}, #{memorySchema}, #{referenceTurns}, COALESCE(#{creator}, ''), COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{updater}, ''), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, NOW()))

INSERT INTO agent_draft (app_id, name, config, status, agent_type, memory_schema, reference_turns, creator, create_time, updater, update_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{name}, #{config}, #{status}, #{agentType}, #{memorySchema}, #{referenceTurns}, COALESCE(#{creator}, ''), COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{updater}, ''), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, NOW())) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), config = VALUES(config), status = VALUES(status), agent_type = VALUES(agent_type), memory_schema = VALUES(memory_schema), reference_turns = VALUES(reference_turns), updater = VALUES(updater), update_time = NOW()
